title: Program Administration Manager
description:
Campaigns

  • Full Time
  • Remote / Occasional Travel
  • Salary $75,000 - $100,000

Organization Overview

Greenlight America is the leading grassroots campaign force powering the nation's clean energy transition at the local level. Our team supports local residents and organizations working to get clean energy built in their communities. Since our founding in 2023, we have enabled volunteers to advance thousands of megawatts' worth of utility-scale projects across the country, helping hundreds of communities to say yes to the benefits of a clean energy future.

Position Overview

Greenlight America is hiring a Program Administration Manager to help lead program administration and operations for our growing campaigns department.

The Program Administration Manager supports the Senior Director of Campaigns in running a growing department. They build department-wide systems, support internal communications, and lead special projects, while also managing core operational functions and providing executive support to the Senior Director. Greenlight's campaigns department has scaled quickly, growing from a single person to more than 30 staff in under three years. This role is well suited to someone excited by that stage of growth, who is comfortable identifying gaps in fast-built systems and bringing the structure and sophistication needed for the department's next chapter. The successful candidate will be a highly organized, proactive problem-solver who thrives in a fast-paced environment, takes initiative to build better systems, and brings strong professional judgment. They will genuinely enjoy working as part of a team and build trust easily across people and functions. The Program Administration Manager reports to the Senior Director of Campaigns.

Primary Roles And Responsibilities

Program Administration â 50%

  • Design and improve department-wide systems and structures, working closely with the Senior Director to identify gaps and build practical, scalable solutions.
  • Serve as the lead for the department retreat and other all-team convenings, from logistics through content flow.
  • Design onboarding, structure, and support systems for a new department internship/fellowship program.
  • Establish and maintain a regular department communication cadence (e.g. weekly updates, department call recaps), including best practices and norms for internal comms.
  • Draft and/or coordinate internal communications on behalf of the Senior Director, including the weekly department update.
  • Maintain organized department files, shared resources, and documentation so the team can work efficiently.
  • Support culture and engagement efforts for the department, in partnership with the Senior Director.
  • Provide light-touch executive support to the Senior Director, including coordinating travel logistics and arranging team gestures for staff.
  • Take on ad hoc special projects at the Senior Director's direction as departmental needs evolve.

Campaign Operations Management â 50%

  • Coordinate with Ops on the campaigns department's budget management, including designing better systems for tracking expenditures, flagging variances, and working with staff and finance to keep spending on track.
  • Identify gaps in departmental operations systems and processes and develop practical solutions that scale with the team's growth.
  • Manage campaign operational workflows such as contractor invoicing and train campaign staff on those workflows.
  • Build and maintain campaign systems for accurate expense categorization, ensuring campaign staff understand and follow financial protocols.
  • Proactively coordinate work across campaign staff, operations staff, and other key stakeholders using clear, direct, and thoughtful communication.
  • Drive adoption of financial and operational practices through effective communication, rollout, and follow-up.
  • Serve as a responsive point of contact for campaign staff, contractors, and others, addressing operational questions with a caring, helpful approach.
  • Support onboarding coordination for new campaigns department hires.

Experience And Qualifications

We are especially interested in candidates with the following qualifications:

  • 3+ years of relevant program administration or operations experience, ideally in a nonprofit, campaign, or mission-driven environment.
  • Strong organizational skills and exceptional attention to detail, with a track record of building and implementing systems and processes. Familiarity with project management and automation tools (e.g. Asana, Zapier) is a plus.
  • Experience rolling out new processes and driving adoption with a team, including situations without direct management authority.
  • Experience with budget management and financial tracking; comfort working with spreadsheets and financial data.
  • Experience working with a senior leader to translate department priorities and goals into action.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience drafting communications on behalf of senior leaders.
  • Comfort and experience building relationships, communicating, and coordinating work with staff across an organization, including leadership and staff outside the assigned department.
  • Demonstrated ability to act as a responsive point of contact to field incoming questions, support problem-solving, and resolve issues in a way that builds trust.
  • Exercises discretion and good judgment when handling sensitive information.
  • Excitement for taking systems built in a fast-growing organization and bringing them to the next level of maturity and sophistication; comfortable identifying problems and building solutions from scratch.
  • Proactive, self-directed work style with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
  • Comfort in a fast-growing organization where processes are still being built and flexibility is required.
  • Passion for accelerating the clean energy transition.

Compensation And Benefits

The base annual salary for this position is $75,000-$100,000. We offer an excellent benefits package which includes 100% employer paid premiums for medical, dental, and vision insurance, unlimited paid time off, monthly technology stipend, and retirement contributions through 401k and Roth plans.

title: Machine Learning Engineer (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Mission

Du bringst Machine-Learning- und KI-Systeme aus dem Prototypen in eine saubere, robuste Produktion.

Bei Agentur Philipp bauen wir KI-Lösungen für den Mittelstand, die messbar Arbeit abnehmen: Computer Vision, intelligente Dokumentenverarbeitung, RAG-Systeme, Sprach- und Automatisierungslösungen.

Dafür suchen wir einen Machine Learning Engineer, der Modelle nicht nur trainieren kann, sondern sie als zuverlässige Systeme baut, integriert, testet und betreibt.

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst und produktivierst Machine-Learning- und Deep-Learning-Modelle für reale Kundenprobleme.
  • Du baust Computer-Vision-Lösungen für Bild-, Video- und Dokumentenverarbeitung, zum Beispiel mit OpenCV, YOLO, OCR oder Vision Language Models.
  • Du entwickelst und integrierst RAG- und LLM-Systeme, die zuverlässig mit unternehmensinternen Daten arbeiten.
  • Du entwickelst Python-Services und APIs, zum Beispiel mit FastAPI, und bindest sie in unsere Kundenlösungen ein.
  • Du setzt Training, Fine-Tuning, Inference, Evaluation und Monitoring für Modelle sauber auf.
  • Du sorgst mit Docker und Linux für reproduzierbare, wartbare und sichere Deployments.
  • Du optimierst Inference und Infrastruktur für Leistung, Kosten und Zuverlässigkeit.
  • Du arbeitest mit Data Scientists, Entwicklern und Delivery eng zusammen, damit aus fachlichen Anforderungen produktionsreife Systeme werden.
  • Du dokumentierst Architektur, Schnittstellen und Betriebslogik so, dass andere im Team darauf aufbauen können.

Das bringst du mit

  • Sehr gute Python-Kenntnisse und praktische Erfahrung mit PyTorch, TensorFlow oder vergleichbaren ML-Frameworks.
  • Erfahrung darin, ML- oder Deep-Learning-Modelle in echten Anwendungen produktiv einzusetzen.
  • Praktische Erfahrung mit Computer Vision, etwa OpenCV, YOLO, Object Detection, Segmentierung, OCR oder Bildklassifikation.
  • Erfahrung mit LLMs und RAG-Systemen, inklusive Embeddings, Vektordatenbanken, Retrieval und Evaluation.
  • Erfahrung mit Docker, Linux und dem Betrieb von Services oder Datenpipelines.
  • Erfahrung mit APIs und Backend-Entwicklung, idealerweise FastAPI.
  • Du denkst in Tests, Fehlerfällen, Logging, Monitoring und Wiederholbarkeit. Ein Notebook allein ist für dich kein fertiges Produkt.
  • Du arbeitest eigenständig, pragmatisch und übernimmst technische Verantwortung.
  • Deutsch C1

Das ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss

  • Erfahrung mit MLOps, etwa MLflow, CI/CD, Kubernetes, Terraform oder Modell-Monitoring.
  • Erfahrung mit ONNX, TensorRT, GPU-Inference, Quantisierung oder Fine-Tuning.
  • Erfahrung mit AWS, Azure, GCP oder lokalen GPU- und On-Premise-Deployments.
  • Erfahrung mit Dokumenten-KI, PDF-Extraktion, OCR oder multimodalen Modellen.
  • Erfahrung mit JavaScript oder Node.js für die Anbindung an Produkt- und Automatisierungssysteme.

Qualifikation

Was dich bei uns erwartet

  • Keine PoCs, die nach der Präsentation verschwinden. Du baust Systeme, die bei Kunden produktiv laufen müssen.
  • Anspruchsvolle Projekte rund um KI-Kollegen, Computer Vision, Dokumentenverarbeitung, RAG und Automatisierung.
  • Viel technischer Gestaltungsspielraum und die Möglichkeit, Engineering-Standards mit aufzubauen.
  • Direkter Kontakt zu den Menschen, die Entscheidungen treffen. Wenig Politik, kurze Wege und schnelle Umsetzung.
  • Ein Team mit hohem fachlichen Anspruch und bodenständiger Zusammenarbeit.
  • Remote-freundliches Arbeiten mit regelmäßigem persönlichem Austausch in Dingolfing. Für die finale Gesprächsrunde möchten wir dich vor Ort kennenlernen.

Benefits

Über Agentur Philipp

Agentur Philipp ist eine KI-Umsetzungsberatung für den Mittelstand. Wir beraten nicht nur, sondern bauen Systeme, die im Alltag funktionieren, Aufwand reduzieren und einen messbaren Unterschied machen.

Unsere Haltung ist klar: Wirkung, Durchziehen, Verstehen, Weiterdenken und Besser werden.

Dann schick uns deinen Lebenslauf, GitHub-, Portfolio- oder Projektlinks und gern eine kurze Beschreibung eines Systems, das du selbst produktiv gebaut oder verantwortet hast. Wichtig ist uns nicht, dass dein Lebenslauf perfekt aussieht. Wichtig ist, dass du zeigen kannst, wie du aus einem Modell ein robustes Produkt machst.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.

description:
You will build payment infrastructure for a sector that is running out of capacity and we are all depending on.

By 2050, 38 million people across the EU will need long-term care, and the sector already lacks the workforce to deliver it. Care organisations need technology that gives professionals more time for people. We build the payment infrastructure that makes this possible.

Your job: build and ship the products for it.

Parto is the all-in-one payments platform for social care organisations. We digitise cash, expense, and payment processes in youth services, disability support, and elderly care - making them simple, secure, and fully digital.

With Parto Visa cards and our software platform, care professionals can efficiently manage client funds, team budgets, and everyday operational expenses. We reduce administrative work, eliminate disconnected processes, and create lasting relief for care teams, administration, and finance departments.

Parto is backed by Motive Ventures New York/Berlin, Heal Capital Berlin and Shapers Lisbon, plus experienced business angels.

You will join an ambitious team whose experience includes Trade Republic, JPMorgan Chase, CHECK24 Bank, Strategy&, and Ruuky. Together, we are building a new category of financial software for one of society's most important sectors.

Tasks

As Product Manager at Parto, you will play a defining role in the future of our platform.

You will be our second product manager, working directly with our founder and CPO, alongside a product designer and an engineering team of 11. Small team, large surface area: your decisions ship.

You will build digital financial products for the social care sector and help modernise an industry that urgently needs better technology. Your work will solve real problems and shape how thousands of professionals manage money every day.

This is not a role in which requirements are handed to you. You will own initiatives from the first customer insight through discovery, prioritisation, delivery, launch, adoption, and continuous improvement.

You will work AI-native from day one. Every PM at Parto uses AI agents daily for discovery, analysis, specs, and delivery. We expect you to push what a single PM can own.

Together with engineering and product design, you will ensure that we solve the right problems and turn them into products that create measurable value.

Your responsibilities include:

  • Develop a deeper understanding of our users, their workflows, and their constraints than anyone else in the company.
  • Translate customer conversations, user feedback, product data, regulatory requirements, and company goals into clear product decisions.
  • Own and prioritise your roadmap based on outcomes and strategic leverage, and make difficult scope decisions while keeping your team moving at high speed.
  • Lead discovery and turn ambiguous problems into clear hypotheses, requirements, and measures of success.
  • Work closely with engineering and product design from the earliest idea through launch, adoption, and iteration.
  • Own integrations with external partners and third-party systems, including the operational details required to make them successful.
  • Contribute to Parto's long-term product strategy and help define the category we intend to lead.

What success looks like in your first six months

Months 1-2: Understand and take ownership

You develop a detailed understanding of our users, product, business model, and technology. You establish strong relationships with customers and your engineering counterparts, challenge existing assumptions, and take ownership of your first product area.

Months 3-4: Ship and learn

You lead your first meaningful initiative from problem definition to launch. You establish clear success metrics, remove blockers quickly, and build a direct feedback loop between customers and the product team.

Months 5-6: Raise the bar

You independently drive your roadmap, make difficult prioritisation decisions, and demonstrate measurable impact. Your understanding of customers begins to shape Parto's broader product strategy.

We work with real startup intensity. The pace is high, the problems are unsolved, and the learning curve is steep. If you are looking for a quiet position with fixed instructions and a rigid scope, you will not be happy at Parto.

If you want to build a product category from the ground up, take real responsibility, and become better at your craft faster than almost anywhere else, we would love to meet you.

What working at Parto means

  • You make consequential decisions yourself and take responsibility for the results.
  • Feedback is direct, frequent, and expected in both directions.
  • You create clarity instead of waiting for perfect instructions.
  • You move quickly without compromising on the quality of important decisions.
  • You adapt when new evidence challenges the current plan.
  • The team supports you and trusts you to run your own scope.

Requirements

Must-haves

  • At least three years of product management experience, ideally in FinTech, payments, or another complex B2B SaaS environment.
  • A strong track record of owning products or major initiatives end-to-end and delivering measurable customer or business impact.
  • The ability to turn complex and sometimes conflicting requirements into clear product decisions and priorities.
  • Strong analytical skills and confidence using qualitative and quantitative evidence to make decisions.
  • High agency and relentless ownership. You identify what matters, create a path forward, and stay with the problem until it is solved.
  • A hands-on mindset and the ability to move confidently between product strategy and operational detail.
  • Experience working closely with engineers and product designers in a fast-moving startup or scale-up environment.
  • The ability to build trust with customers and manage internal and external stakeholders at different levels.

Nice-to-haves

  • Experience with ERP integrations or mission-critical B2B software.
  • Experience building products in regulated environments.
  • Understanding of social care, healthcare, or other operationally complex service industries.

We do not expect you to match every item. We care more about your judgement, trajectory, and evidence of exceptional ownership than a perfectly linear CV.

Benefits

title: Senior/Staff Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Vestiaire Collective is the leading global online marketplace for desirable pre-loved fashion. Our mission is to transform the fashion industry for a more sustainable future by empowering our community to promote the circular fashion movement. Vestiaire was founded in 2009 and is headquartered in Paris with offices in London, Berlin, New York, Singapore, Ho Chi Minh, and warehouses in Tourcoing (France), Crawley (UK), Hong Kong and New York.

We currently have a diverse global team of 600 employees representing more than 50 nationalities. Our values are Activism, Transparency, Dedication and Greatness and Collective.

About the Role

We are seeking a Foundational Machine Learning Engineer for a high-impact greenfield opportunity to build our MLOps infrastructure from the ground up at Vestiaire Collective. While driving our AI authentication initiatives (deploying multi-model approaches including computer vision for luxury product authentication and counterfeit detection) will be your immediate focus, your long-term mission will be to scale foundational architecture across the entire marketplace. You will expand our ML capabilities to power broader domains, primarily focusing on search and recommendation systems, with future expansions into dynamic pricing and marketing technologies. Acting as the bridge among Applied Science, Data Platform, and Backend Engineering, you will design robust, decoupled architectures and spearhead the MLOps strategy with our Director of Data, prioritizing system maintainability, engineering hygiene, and the reliable deployment of complex models, ensuring all our ML models across the board deliver high-throughput, low-latency business impact.

What You Will Do

  • Short-Term Impact (First 6 Months): Partner closely with the Operations squads and Data Scientists to accelerate ML and RAG prototypes into resilient, production-ready code. You will directly integrate with the team to deploy, optimize, and scale heavy-width CV and VLM models focused on fraud detection and luxury product authentication, immediately improving our trust and safety ecosystem.

  • Mid-Term Foundation (MLOps Lifecycle & Infrastructure): Lead the end-to-end foundational groundwork of our ML lifecycle by designing robust systems for Data & Feature Management, Model Tracking & Registry, and Model Serving & Monitoring. You will scale infrastructure by automating continuous retraining pipelines that handle diverse deployment cadences (from daily fraud detection to weekly recommendations), design resilient multi-model architectures, and critically evaluate the technical overhead and TCO of our in-house tools against enterprise-grade platforms to ensure long-term resilience.

  • Long-Term Vision (Centralizing 360-Degree MLE Capabilities): Act as a pioneer and cornerstone hire for the ML engineering discipline at Vestiaire Collective, setting the technical standards to help scale the AI/ML organization. You will transition into a centralized foundational role, moving beyond single-squad operations to mentor the team and provide horizontal ML infrastructure support to multiple domains, including Search, Discovery, Pricing, Marketing, and Data Platforms.

Who You Are

Must-Haves:

  • Experience: 5-8+ years of hands-on experience in Machine Learning Engineering, specifically focused on building and scaling MLOps infrastructure and productionizing ML systems.

  • Production Infrastructure: Proven expertise in deploying low-latency, high-throughput ML inference services (using FastAPI, TorchServe, Triton Inference Server, or Ray Serve) across both classical lightweight and heavy-width ML models (PyTorch/TensorFlow). Strong preference for AWS (EKS, EC2, SageMaker) / Snowflake and Open Source ecosystems over GCP/Azure.

  • MLOps & Pipelines: Deep experience building automated, continuous model retraining pipelines to handle concept drift (ranging from daily to weekly cycles). You have orchestrated decoupled, multi-model AI architectures using tools like Airflow, Kubeflow, or Metaflow, and possess strong expertise in model registry and tracking tools like MLflow or Weights & Biases.

  • Feature Stores: Hands-on experience evaluating, building, or extensively leveraging online (Redis, DynamoDB) and offline (Snowflake, S3) Feature Stores in a production environment. Familiarity with frameworks like Feast or custom dbt-based pipelines is highly valued.

  • Strategic Builder Mindset: You are an analytical builder who thinks long-term. You can successfully evaluate TCO for bespoke internal systems versus enterprise tools, anticipate technical liabilities, and design robust architectures that handle unpredictable peak traffic surges.

  • Collaboration & Engineering Hygiene: Strong cross-functional communication skills. You excel at translating complex ML prototypes into highly scalable production code backed by strict version control, rigorous testing, and CI/CD best practices, seamlessly connecting data science innovation with backend engineering execution.

Nice-to-Haves:

  • Relevant Domain Expertise: Background in E-commerce, Single-SKU Marketplaces, Search & Recommendation, Trust & Safety, or Counterfeit Detection.

  • Vision, Edge & Optimization: Hands-on experience with Vector Databases, Visual RAG pipelines, deploying Deep Learning VLM models, and optimizing models for edge computing or low-latency inference (e.g., ONNX, TensorRT).

Infrastructure & Observability: Advanced experience with containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), and data transformation workflows (dbt). Familiarity with setting up advanced monitoring for model performance, concept drift, and system health (Datadog, Prometheus).
What we offer 🎁

A meaningful job with an impact on the way people consume fashion and promote sustainability
The opportunity to do career-defining work in a fast-growing French-born scale up
The possibility to work as part of a globally diverse team with more than 50 nationalities 
Two days to help Project - reinforcing your activist journey and volunteer for an association
Significant investment in your learning and growth
Competitive compensation and benefits package (i.e 28 days of paid time off)

TikTok Shop verändert gerade, wie Menschen online einkaufen – und du kannst von Anfang an mit dabei sein.

Werde Teil einer der gefragtesten TikTok-Shop-Agenturen Europas und übernimm Verantwortung für Creator Management und operative Umsetzung.

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben

  • Marken-Verantwortung: Du betreust eine Auswahl unserer Kernmarken als dedizierter Ansprechpartner – von der Creator-Strategie bis zur Performance, immer mit dem Markenbild im Blick.
  • Trend- & Formatentwicklung: Du erkennst aufkommende TikTok-Trends frühzeitig und entwickelst daraus neue Content-Formate, die konvertieren und skalieren.
  • Creator Coaching: Du unterstützt unsere Affiliate-Partner aktiv – mit Hooks, Trend-Insights und Content-Feedback – damit ihre Videos nicht nur gut aussehen, sondern auch verkaufen.
  • Creator Scouting & Aufbau: Du identifizierst vielversprechende Creator, holst sie an Bord und entwickelst langfristige Partnerschaften statt kurzfristiger Einzelaktionen.
  • Creative Briefing: Du übersetzt Markenziele in klare, praxisnahe Briefings, die Creators befähigen, TikTok-nativen Content zu produzieren, der performt.
  • TikTok-Zusammenarbeit: Du bist im regelmäßigen Austausch mit TikToks eigenen Teams, bleibst bei Algorithmus-Updates auf dem Laufenden und nutzt neue Features gezielt für deine Marken.

Qualifikation

Dein Profil

  • Erste Erfahrungen im Influencer Marketing, Talent Management oder Social Media – idealerweise mit Fokus auf messbare Ergebnisse
  • Du bist selbst auf TikTok zuhause, erkennst Trends bevor sie peaken, und weißt wie man daraus ein wiederholbares Format macht
  • Du verstehst, wie TikTok-Hooks funktionieren, was Social Commerce ausmacht und wie man Creator-Content gezielt optimiert
  • Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau, gute Englischkenntnisse für die interne Abstimmung
  • Du wohnst in Köln oder bist bereit, umzuziehen

Benefits

Was dich erwartet

  • Direkte Wirkung: Flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege – deine Ideen landen nicht in endlosen Abstimmungsrunden, sondern werden umgesetzt.
  • „Day-One“-Mentalität: Wir sind schnell. Dich erwartet ein internationales, energiegeladenes Team, in dem Ideen nicht in Meetings stecken bleiben, sondern umgesetzt werden.
  • Echtes Wachstum: Du baust Expertise auf, die gerade zu den gefragtesten im digitalen Marketing gehört – Creator, E-Commerce, Live-Shopping.
  • Starkes Team: International, schnell und mit einer offenen Atmosphäre – wir arbeiten hart und feiern das auch.

Was wir suchen

Wir suchen jemanden, der verstanden hat: Auf TikTok ist Content das Produkt. Wenn du den Spagat zwischen viralen Trends und messbaren Verkaufsergebnissen beherrschst, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Über uns

GENUINE ist einer der führenden TikTok-Shop-Partner in Deutschland mit Büros in Köln, Berlin, Shanghai und Hongkong. Unser Team bringt über neun Jahre Erfahrung aus dem Social-Commerce-Markt in China und Südostasien mit. Gegründet 2017 von Damian Maib in Shanghai, haben wir deutschen Marken geholfen, im chinesischen Markt Fuß zu fassen und Millionen von Konsumenten zu erreichen. Seit 2025 sind wir auch in Europa aktiv und unterstützen Unternehmen beim Aufbau ihrer TikTok Shops.

title: Senior Data Scientist (m/f/d)
description:
At Flix, we offer a tech-driven environment where innovation meets real-world impact, with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a culture of collaboration and ownership.  

We're looking for a motivated and skilled Senior Data Scientist to join our Team Greenrock – Demand Division. 

Our Tech team owns Flix's Revenue Management System (RMS), a production system with a direct commercial impact. We are looking for a colleague who will play an active role in shaping the next generation of the RMS by leveraging their deep expertise in revenue management. 

This is a hands-on senior role in a non-greenfield environment: delivering meaningful change requires care, conviction, and patience. 

About the Role

  • Work closely with commercial stakeholders to translate business requirements into well-scoped projects and respond to operational inquiries.
  • Translate revenue management theory and industry best practices into concrete, testable improvements, from idea and experimentation through to production rollout.
  • Co-own the evolution of the entire system through regular collaboration and discussions with peers across your team and neighboring engineering teams.
  • Contribute to the technical health, reliability, and observability of the existing system. 

About You

Education and Revenue Management expertise (must-have)

  • Advanced degree (Master's or PhD) in Operations Research, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related quantitative field
  • Solid theoretical foundation in RM: demand modeling, dynamic pricing, and network revenue management.
  • Applied experience with RM or pricing tech solutions in transportation, travel, hospitality, retail, or a comparable domain is a big plus. 

Engineering and data craft 

  • Strong hands-on Python (including NumPy, Polars, Pandas, SciPy) and comfort with SQL on large datasets.
  • Production-code experience is welcome but not required; what we expect is genuine interest in writing, reviewing, and maintaining code that runs reliably in production. 

Soft skills 

  • Excellent communication: you explain complex quantitative concepts or optimisation trade-offs to technical and non-technical, commercial audiences alike, and you enjoy educating and advocating for sound RM solutions.
  • Senior judgment: you scope your own work, balance short-term fixes with long-term direction, and respect the constraints of an existing system. 

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!  

What We Offer

  • Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family. 
  • Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year. 
  • Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life. 
  • Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members. 
  • Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills. 
  • Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career. 

To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career

Why Join Flix?

At Flix, we empower our teams to push boundaries and shape the future of mobility. As we continue to scale globally, we harness cutting-edge technology to make mobility smarter, more sustainable, and more affordable.

If you're looking for a place where you can drive change and redefine how millions of people travel, Flix is the place where you can lead your journey!

  • A culture that values personal and professional development, with internal mobility opportunities.
  • A supportive and open-minded team that embraces diverse perspectives and innovative ideas.
  • 32 days of paid vacation plus your birthday off, giving you the time you need to recharge.
  • A flexible hybrid working scheme to balance work and life.
  • Access to a learning budget and internal training to help you grow in your role.
  • Mental health coaching to support your well-being.
  • Regular global and local get-togethers to celebrate successes and build connections.
  • The possibility of taking a sabbatical after three years with the company.
  • A cloud-based company setup, providing flexibility and collaboration opportunities no matter where you are.

*These are global benefits that apply to all employees, with additional local perks based on your location.

Responsibilities:

In this role, you will:

  • Design and develop modern architectures using Java, AWS technologies, microservices, NoSQL & RDBMS, event-driven architectures, etc.
  • Be involved in the inception, development, and delivery of various features and products on an ambitious and challenging product roadmap.
  • Take responsibility for our solution architecture and contribute to improving it in terms of performance, security, scalability, modularity, and operational efficiency.
  • Be involved in multiple projects at the same time and manage your time effectively.
  • Conduct knowledge-sharing sessions through presentations and hands-on tasks that help practice new technologies.

 Your Profile:

We're looking for someone with 6+ years of experience, who is dedicated to creating exceptional user experiences and driving innovation.

  • 6+ years of experience in designing and developing complex modular applications from technical planning to implementation within a client-side framework as well as server-side.
  • Strong knowledge and active hands-on experience of Java and SpringBoot.
  • Object-oriented programming concepts with application to concurrent event-based systems.
  • Previous knowledge and experience with JS (TypeScript, NodeJS), HTML, CSS and React/Angular.
  • Knowledge of AWS technologies such as DynamoDB, Elasticsearch, relational and NoSQL databases, EventBridge and messaging and queuing solutions like SQS, SNS (or any other cloud platform like Google Cloud or Azure).
  • Experience with GraphQL, federation and Supergraph concepts.
  • Excellent understanding of common design/architectural patterns, and the ability to produce elegant designs in modular/microservice design patterns.
  • Logical, analytic thinking, structured and target-oriented approach, very good problem-solving skills.
  • Passion for delivering clean code, unit/integration tests and maintainable documentation.
  • Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and DevOps best practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to support and mentor more junior members of a software development team.
  • BS degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Excellent communication skills and fluency in written and spoken English.

title: Finance & Operations Manager (m/f/d)
description:
About GENUINE

GENUINE is at the forefront of the social commerce revolution. As a fast-growing TikTok Shop Agency, we don’t just create content—we build high-converting shopping experiences. We operate at the intersection of entertainment and commerce, moving at the speed of a viral trend.

To fuel our next stage of growth, we are looking for a data-driven Finance & Operations Manager who thrives in a high-speed environment.

The Mission

You will be the architect of our financial engine. Your goal is to ensure that as our GMV (Gross Merchandise Value) is strongly growing, our margins remain healthy and our cash flow stays liquid.

You will bridge the gap between TikTok’s backend data, our payouts, and our internal profitability.

Aufgaben

Your Key Responsibilities

  • Revenue & Commission Reconciliation: Manage the complex flow of funds from TikTok Shop, including platform fees, affiliate payouts, and client disbursements.
  • Performance Controlling: Analyze the ROI of creator campaigns and live-stream sessions.
  • You tell us which creators are profitable and which aren't. Cash Flow & Payout Management: Ensure creators and partners are paid accurately and on time while optimizing our own working capital.
  • Process Automation: You will help implement and oversee tools that connect TikTok Shop data with our accounting software
  • Commercial Strategy: Support the leadership team in pricing our services—moving from pure retainers to performance-based models (revenue share).

Qualifikation

Your Profile

  • Experience: 2-4 years in Finance, Controlling, or Ops. Experience in E-commerce, D2C brands, or Affiliate Marketing is a massive plus.
  • Data Literacy: You are a Google Sheets/Excel wizard. You don't just see numbers; you see patterns and "leaks" in the funnel.
  • Agility: You thrive in "organized chaos." A TikTok algorithm change doesn't scare you; you adapt the reporting by EOD.
  • Tech Savvy: Familiarity with e-commerce backends (Shopify, TikTok Shop Seller Center) and modern fintech tools (Spendesk, Moss, etc.).

Benefits

What’s In It For You

  • Front-Row Seats to the Future: Join the #1 TikTok Shop partner in Germany. You won’t just be watching social commerce grow; you’ll be the one building it across Europe for the world’s most iconic brands.
  • A "Day One" Culture: We move fast. Enjoy an international, high-vibe team environment where your ideas don't get stuck in meetings—they get executed.
  • Direct Impact, Zero Red Tape: Work in a flat hierarchy where you collaborate directly with seasoned experts and have the autonomy to own your projects.
  • The Cologne Lifestyle: Our modern HQ is located right in the heart of Cologne, surrounded by the city's best energy (and coffee).
  • Serious Growth: Whether it’s client management, creative production, or deep-dive e-commerce, you’ll be gaining a toolkit that is currently the most in-demand in the global marketing industry.
  • Team Spirit: We work hard, but we celebrate even harder with regular team events and an appreciative, open atmosphere.

We are the largest TikTok Shop partner in Europe, and we are looking for someone to help us bridge the gap between creative production and modern e-commerce. If you’re ready to lead the social commerce revolution in Europe, we’re ready for you.

About Us:

GENUINE is one of Germany's leading TikTok Shop partners with offices in Shanghai, Cologne, Hong Kong, and Berlin. Our team brings more than nine years of experience from the social commerce market in China and Southeast Asia. GENUINE was founded in 2017 by Damian Maib in Shanghai. There, we helped German brands gain a successful foothold in China and position their products in front of millions of consumers. Since 2025, we have also been active in Europe, assisting leading companies in setting up their TikTok Shops.

  • Du hast Freude daran, Kundenbeziehungen aufzubauen und weiterzuentwickeln und diese gezielt als Vertriebsmöglichkeit zu nutzen
  • Du verfügst über ein breites Netzwerk in der Payment-/Bankenbranche
  • Du arbeitest strukturiert, trittst sicher auf und überzeugst in Präsentationen
  • Kommunikation gehört zu deinen Stärken – du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch
  • Du übernimmst die Gesamtverantwortung für die Entwicklung der Business Unit mit hoher Eigeninitiative,
  • Entscheidungsfreude und ausgeprägtem unternehmerischem Denken
  • Du bist reisebereit und zeitlich felxibel

Benefits

title: (Senior) Launch Manager (m/w/d)
description:
Wir sind fest davon überzeugt, dass Padel ein magischer Sport ist – einer, der Menschen durch seine einzigartige Kombination aus Leichtigkeit, Dynamik und sozialer Interaktion begeistert. Padel ist für alle da: von Jung bis Alt, vom Anfänger bis zum Profi – jeder kann an dieser Leidenschaft teilhaben. Es ist mehr als nur ein Spiel; es ist ein Erlebnis, das verbindet, Freude bereitet und Freundschaften schafft.

mitte ist ein Boutique Padel Club, der erstklassige Spielbedingungen und ein stilvolles Umfeld für unsere dynamische, moderne Community bietet. Unsere Clubs kombinieren hochwertige Einrichtung in zentralen innerstädtischen Standorten mit digitaler Innovation und menschlicher Wärme, um Padel zu einem festen Bestandteil des Alltags zu machen – sei es für ein schnelles Spiel oder als „Third Place“ für verschiedenste Erlebnisse.

Was uns besonders macht:

  • Unsere Indoor-Clubs sind so gelegen, dass man sie in unter 15 Minuten erreichen kann – ideal für den urbanen Alltag
  • Unsere vollautomatisierten Systeme sorgen für ein reibungsloses, modernes Spielerlebnis
  • Unsere Community Leader leben Gastfreundschaft und hospitality-like Betreuung und widmen sich voll und ganz der Aufgabe, hervorragende Gastgeber zu sein
  • Unser Interior Design stammt von einem renommierten Boutique-Architekten

Unsere Ambition: Die globale Brand für Premium Padel zu werden.

Aufgaben

Als (Sr.) Launch Manager entwickelst du ein skalierbares Modell für die Eröffnung neuer Clubs in ganz Europa. Du verantwortest den gesamten Launch-Prozess, von der Übergabe durch Planning & Construction bis zur erfolgreichen operativen Übergabe an Field Operations. Du stellst sicher, dass jeder neue oder akquirierte Standort pünktlich, im Budget und nach den definierten Standards integriert wird. Dabei entwickelst du das Launch Playbook kontinuierlich weiter und sorgst dafür, dass jeder Launch den nächsten besser macht.

Du berichtest an die COO und arbeitest eng mit Planning & Construction, Central Operations, Field Operations, Commercial, Brand, Finance und People zusammen.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Launch Playbook: Du entwickelst und verantwortest das Launch Playbook von mitte – die zentrale Referenz dafür, wie neue Clubs eröffnet und integriert werden. Du definierst Standards, Rollen, Meilensteine, Governance und Best Practices und entwickelst das Playbook anhand der Learnings aus jedem Launch kontinuierlich weiter.
  • Launch Management: Du verantwortest den gesamten Launch neuer Clubs, von der Übergabe durch Planning & Construction bis zur erfolgreichen operativen Übergabe an Field Operations. Du stellst sicher, dass jeder Standort pünktlich, im Budget und nach den definierten Standards eröffnet wird.
  • Launch Readiness: Du stellst sicher, dass alle Voraussetzungen für eine erfolgreiche Eröffnung erfüllt sind. Teams, Systeme, Prozesse, Lieferketten, Trainings, Customer Experience und operative Standards müssen vor dem Go-live vollständig implementiert sein.
  • Launch Scaling: Du entwickelst die Launch-Organisation kontinuierlich weiter und stellst sicher, dass mehrere Cluberöffnungen parallel erfolgreich umgesetzt werden können. Du priorisierst Ressourcen, schaffst Transparenz über Zeitpläne, Budgets und Risiken.
  • Continuous Improvement: Du analysierst jeden Launch, identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale und sorgst dafür, dass Erkenntnisse unmittelbar in das Launch Playbook sowie in die Zusammenarbeit mit Construction, Central Operations und Field Operations einfließen.
  • Stakeholder Management: Du verantwortest das Stakeholder Management über alle Launches hinweg und schaffst Alignment zwischen internen und externen Partnern. Du moderierst Zielkonflikte, löst Abhängigkeiten frühzeitig auf und stellst sicher, dass Entscheidungen schnell und im Sinne eines erfolgreichen Launchs getroffen werden.

Das Besondere an dieser Rolle ist, dass…

  • Du verantwortest die Umsetzung europaweite Launch-Strategie von mitte
  • Du entwickelst das Launch Playbook weiter und schaffst die Standards für ein skalierbares Wachstum über mehrere Länder hinweg.
  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der COO / Mitgründerin bei kurzen Entscheidungswegen.

Qualifikation

  • 3-5 Jahre Erfahrung im Projekt-, Launch- oder Operations-Management in einem schnell wachsenden Multi-Site-Unternehmen.
  • Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Steuerung komplexer, bereichsübergreifender Rollouts, Neueröffnungen.
  • Erfahrung im Aufbau standardisierter Prozesse, Playbooks und skalierbarer Rollout-Modelle.
  • Ausgeprägte Organisations- und Priorisierungsfähigkeit sowie die Fähigkeit, mehrere Projekte parallel erfolgreich zu steuern.
  • Strukturierte, analytische und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise – auch bei hoher Geschwindigkeit, Ambiguität und hoher Komplexität.
  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Stakeholder-Management-Fähigkeiten sowie die Fähigkeit, unterschiedliche Funktionen auf gemeinsame Ziele auszurichten.
  • Hohe Reisebereitschaft und Freude daran, regelmäßig Zeit in den Clubs zu verbringen.
  • Hohe Eigenverantwortung, Hands-on-Mentalität und Freude daran, Dinge bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung voranzutreiben.

Benefits

  • Werde Teil einer Erfolgsgeschichte: Unser Ziel ist klar: Europas größter Padel-Operator zu werden. Du bist von Anfang an dabei – mit der Chance, echte Verantwortung zu übernehmen und diese Vision aktiv mitzugestalten.
  • Zentrales Büro im Herzen Berlins: Ein Ort für produktives Arbeiten und offenen Austausch auf Augenhöhe. Snacks & Getränke stehen selbstverständlich bereit.
  • Modernes Equipment: Du arbeitest mit einem MacBook und allem, was du brauchst, um produktiv zu sein.
  • Arbeite direkt mit den Foundern: Du arbeitest eng mit unseren Foundern zusammen und bekommst aus erster Hand mit, wie Entscheidungen getroffen, Strukturen aufgebaut und Strategien entwickelt und umgesetzt werden.
  • Entlohnung: Ein wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt mit langfristigen Entwicklungsperspektiven.
  • Deine Uniform: Wir statten dich mit unserer exklusiven mitte Teamwear von adidas aus.
  • Sport & Wellbeing: Bei uns bekommst du regelmäßige Padel Matches auf unseren Courts - für deinen körperlichen Ausgleich und dein Wohlbefinden neben dem Arbeitsalltag.

Senior Data Modeler (Data Vault)
description:
Visium combines strategy, frontier AI, and deep regulated-industry expertise to build and deploy AI-native systems that reinvent how businesses operate - unlocking the value of AI at scale.

We're not a strategy firm that ships slide decks and walks away. Not a tech consultancy that builds what won't get adopted. Not a product company chasing problems it doesn't understand. We're all three at once: strategy, deep technical and integration expertise, and product, working as one. That combination is our flywheel. Consulting keeps us close to the hardest real-world problems. Products let us solve them at scale. Every engagement sharpens our products; every deployment makes the next engagement faster, deeper, and more certain.

We're obsessed with outcomes. While 95% of enterprise AI pilots never reach production, Visium is built to be the 5% delivering productised AI that compounds in value, not point solutions that deliver marginal gains. We are AI-native, not AI-adjacent. We don't bolt AI onto broken workflows; we redesign them with AI at the core.

Role

As a Senior Data Modeler, you will play a key role in designing and delivering robust, scalable data models that enable our clients to unlock the full value of their data. You will contribute to critical data initiatives by creating reusable, business-aligned data assets that address complex business challenges. Your work will directly support enterprise data strategies and the implementation of modern, automated data solutions.

You will work closely with client teams to ensure data model consistency, quality, and alignment with enterprise architecture and strategic priorities.

By joining Visium, you will work alongside experts in modern data platforms, data scientists, machine learning engineers, and AI specialists. Our focus is on enabling customers to make their AI use cases enterprise-ready. Since the quality and preparation of data are crucial for AI success, your role will ultimately empower customers to be ready for an AI-driven future.

As an Expert Data Modeler, this is part of your day-to-day activities:

  • Translate complex business needs into robust models (focus Data Vault 2.0), including conceptual, logical, and physical layers.
  • Design and implement scalable, auditable data products using Data Vault patterns.
  • Ensure modeling consistency and alignment with enterprise standards, especially across multiple data domains and delivery teams.
  • Collaborate with client stakeholders and data teams to clarify requirements, define model scope, and align on delivery timelines.
  • Integrate models with modern data platforms with state-of-the-art toolchains (CI/CD, Git)
  • Act as a subject matter expert on modeling approaches, mentoring peers and guiding teams on advanced Data Vault use cases.

Requirements

To apply, this should be part of your background:

  • 4+ years of experience in data modeling, with a proven track record of delivering enterprise-scale data solutions.
  • Experience in data modelling techniques (Dimensional, Data Vault)
  • Understanding of conceptual, logical, and physical data modeling and their application in modern data ecosystems.
  • Solid grasp of data governance principles, metadata management, and maintaining business term alignment across models.
  • Experience working in agile environments with a DevOps toolchain (CI/CD, Git, Automation tools)
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work closely with cross-functional client teams.
  • Fluency in SQL and experience integrating models into data pipelines and BI/reporting layers.
  • Ability to mentor peers and guide modeling decisions, serving as a trusted expert within project teams.
  • Fluent in English.
  • This role involves frequent travelling to Barcelona or any other client site.

Plus:

  • Data Vault 2.0 certification
  • Experience with dbt and Databricks
  • CI/CD practices and pull request workflows for data models.

We know that great candidates might not check every box. If you’re excited about this role and believe you could contribute, we’d love to hear from you.

Benefits

What we offer

  • A competitive compensation package
  • A yearly education budget to steep your learning curve
  • A yearly sport budget because a fit body leads to a fit mind
  • A flexible working culture because your work-life balance matters to us
  • A position that enables you to have an impact on 1’000s of people, and the whole company's growth.
  • An international, knowledgeable, and passionate team with a strong collaborative mindset

Check our LinkedIn and website to learn more about us & don’t hesitate to contact us if you have any questions.

description:
Trusted Shops creates digital trust between people, businesses, and AI Agents. Every day, millions of consumers rely on our solutions to make confident online decisions, while businesses use our products to build trust, strengthen customer relationships, and grow sustainably. 

With around 700 colleagues across Europe, more than 25,000 online shops, and over 40 million consumers in our Community of Trust, we are helping shape a safer and more transparent digital world. But trust is not only at the heart of our products – it also shapes how we work together. We believe in collaboration, ownership, and the freedom to do your best work through a flexible hybrid work culture. 

Join us and help create a digital world where trust, transparency, and meaningful connections drive every interaction. 

 

To strengthen our Engineering Team, we are looking for a 

Senior Software Engineer - Identity & Agent Protocols (f/m/d)

Cologne (hybrid) or Berlin (remote) | Permanent Contract (Full-time) 

We're building the trust layer for agentic & human commerce: a Trust Authority that issues and verifies credentials for AI agents acting on behalf of consumers and shops. The protocol, the APIs and the UI - you would be a core engineer on it.

Your Key Responsibilities as a Senior Software Engineer (f/m/d):

  • Design and build the APIs and services behind our Trust Authority - credential issuance, verification, refresh and revocation.

  • Develop cross‑platform Web Components

  • Work with open identity standards such as OAuth2 / OIDC, passkeys, Verifiable Credentials, did:web, Web Bot Auth

  • Own the system design - service boundaries, data models, API contracts - and make the calls that others build on.

  • Build and run it on AWS with Terraform (Lambda, ECS, API Gateway, DynamoDB, KMS), including monitoring and alerting.

  • Ingest and analyse agent traffic, and turn raw signals into something we can act on.

  • Own our automated testing: build the end-to-end, contract and visual regression suites in CI (Playwright) from scratch, so we release without manual regression checking.

  • Take features from unclear idea to production and keep them healthy.


  • Strong backend engineering, ideally in Node.js / TypeScript. Depth matters more to us than the specific language - part of our stack is Java (Keycloak).

  • Frontend experience with JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML, CSS.

  • Real API and system design experience: you've designed APIs other teams depend on, and you can explain your trade-offs.

  • Hands-on AWS and infrastructure as code (Terraform). You deploy your own changes.

  • Solid security fundamentals: OAuth2 / OIDC, secure API design, and the basics of signing and key management.

  • You've built automated test suites others rely on, not just tests alongside your own features. Hands-on with a modern E2E framework such as Playwright or Cypress.

  • You're comfortable when the answer isn't known yet, and you decide with incomplete information.

Nice-to-haves:

  • Verifiable Credentials, DIDs, WebAuthn / passkeys, or HTTP message signatures.

  • Event-driven architecture (SNS / SQS) or data pipelines.

  • Web Components (Lit) - parts of our team ship UI that runs inside our customers' websites.

What we offer you:

  • Hybrid work: Combine flexible remote work with team time in the Cologne office (on-site days depending on your location)

  • Workation: Temporarily work from a destination of your choice within EU, Iceland, Liechtenstein or Norway

  • 28 vacation days

  • 2.5 additional days off at Christmas, New Year's Eve and Carnival

  • Buddy program (an experienced trustee is at your side)

  • Events (Team Events, Unit Events, etc.)

A fully owned and operated ecosystem that converges the two worlds of sports media and sports betting. We're proud of the high ratings for our commitment to excellence and fueling fan's passion for sport driving us to the top.

  • Supporting the media planning and delivery of any media deals (in conjunction with the agency)

Skills, Knowledge and Experience 

  • Experience within a similar brand/marketing role (client side or agency)

  • Experienced in managing agencies and working closely with / leading internal teams
  • An effective communicator, well versed in stakeholder management

Our customers include the world's largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. Zipline is seeking a senior, strategic, and highly adaptable lawyer to lead and scale legal and compliance across multiple countries of operation in Africa. You will work cross-functionally with the Africa Leadership Team, Operations, Policy, Government Affairs, People, Finance, and Engineering, and will report directly to Zipline's Deputy General Counsel.

One day you may be advising on a complex Nigerian employment or a healthcare regulatory issue in Cote d'Ivoire; the next, developing compliance training for teams across Africa or helping the business navigate export controls, sanctions, anti-corruption, and other cross-border legal risks.

Cross-Functional Partnership & Culture

  • Act as a senior point of escalation for Claims exceeding individual specialist handlers’ authority limits; ensure that key case decisions are effective, facts-based, and well-considered.

  • Review and challenge Complex Claims case strategies, detailed reserving calculations, litigation approaches, and high-value settlements.

  • Maintain excellent relationships with key Company stakeholders as well as stakeholders across our Capacity / Reinsurance Partners, in regard to the management of Complex Claims.
